hooks.command: python3 -S "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/session_start.py" --provider "$(if [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then printf claude-code; else printf codex; fi)"
hooks.commandWindows: py -3 -S -c "import os,runpy,sys; r=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'); p=os.path.join((r or os.environ['PLUGIN_ROOT']),'hooks','scripts','session_start.py'); v='claude-code' if r else 'codex'; sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(p)); sys.argv=[p,'--provider',v]; runpy.run_path(p, run_name='__main__')"
